versions.content: For each Union Implementation Data Type , the RTE Types Header File shall include the corresponding union declaration as: union Rte_union_<name> { <elements> }; where <elements> is the union element specification and <name> is the Implemen- tation Data Type symbol of the Union Implementation Data Type . For each union element defined by one ImplementationDataTypeElement one union element specification <elements> is defined. The union element specifications are ordered according the order of the related ImplementationDataTypeElement s in the input configuration. Sequent union elements are separated with a semicolon.
